column5: Description
A fortified belt covered with strange jewels and gems, given to you by the Duke of Crows for assisting the Blackfeather Court in Blackwood.
Buried for who knows how long, the pirate captain's hammer still looks to be in perfect condition.

column4: Light foot coverings used by Argonian priests and recovered from the ruins of Xi-Tsei.

column5: Once worn by the fabled Shadowscales, this tunic shows its wear and age from the many years it sat within Bloodrun Cave.
The helm traditionally worn by commanders of the Ivory Brigade brigadines assigned to the Borderwatch Garrison.
A chestpiece once worn by the Scion of Giovesse and presented to you for your efforts exploring the haunted Castle Giovesse.

column2: A Battle of Silk and Flame
column5: A pair of sturdy leggings molded in the realms of Oblivion and discovered in the Doomvault Porcixid.
A gift from the House of Reveries, this well-balanced blade is ideal for juggling, as well as for more violent acts.
A heavily reinforced set of shoulder armor masterly crafted by the best smiths in Leyawiin for the Ivory Brigade militia.
A beautifully carved staff found within the Doomvault Capraxus, where you encountered the twin Ambitions.

column4: Although the outfit that Percius Loche made for you was destroyed in the Deadlands, this necklace managed to survive the ordeal. Dinged but still as beautiful as ever.
A staff crackling with energy found within Xynaa's chambers in the Deadlands.
Awarded to only the highest-ranking members of Keshu's Black Fin Legion, this large hammer is both ceremonial and functional as a weapon.
A special staff made by Faric of Bravil and presented to you for helping him reveal the truth of his family.
A light helm awarded for helping members of the Black Fin Legion with a private and urgent matter.

column5: A set of light shoulder armor found in the depths of the Glenbridge Xanmeer while helping save Lady Laurent's manservant, Stibbons, from a sorcerous voriplasm.
A set of light leggings common to the Argonians of Hutan-Tzel and presented to you by Heem-Jas for helping solve their Imperial problem.

column4: Armored Gauntlets of the Ivory Brigade
column5: A pair of armored gauntlets engraved with Leyawiin's crest for use by the Ivory Brigade militia.

column4: Once wielded by a Waking Flame cultist, this bow represents the Dagonist belief in violent rebellion and destructive change.
Rewarded for saving Nirn from the Daedric Prince, Mehrunes Dagon.
A cloth belt used to hold coins of various types presented to you by Tertia Falto. It's empty. Very empty.
One of several contraband items smuggled by the Fang-Furl gang into Blackwood, these boots fell into your possession while helping the Happy Averno Shipping Company.
A heavy helmet awarded for bringing news of a member's death and their research to the Fighters Guild.

column5: Shoulder armor with the distinct aura of Nocturnal, the Daedric Prince of Shadow.

An axe coated with a unique concoction, making its blade corrosive to organic material. Although originally intended for cutting through thick vines, it works fine against plants, minerals, and animals.
This shield symbolized the steadfast protective nature of the legendary Argonian defenders, the Four Winds.
Crudely made but sharp enough to separate any enemy's head from their shoulders, this greataxe was a reward for your efforts in Undertow Cavern.
A ring worn by members of the prestigious Dunmeri House, Terithi, received for your assistance at the ruins of Veyond.
A set of thick leather gloves used to bathe hogs while also offering good protection. Given to you by Hokatsei for aiding her brother in the ruins of Vunalk.
Made from stone but polished to the sharpness of fine steel, this dagger has dispatched many victims in the Xi-Tsei xanmeer.
Engraved with a symbol of an anvil, this ring signifies its bearer as one who has accomplished great toil in Zenithar's name.
